morphology.pattern_note: 外来人名，作为整体记忆；不能按马来语词缀拆分。正常书写首字母大写。

senses.zh_definition: 斯特法诺：意大利语男性名字，在马来语语境中作为人名使用。
senses.en_definition: An Italian masculine given name used as a personal name in Malay discourse.
senses.ms_definition: Nama khas lelaki dalam bahasa Itali yang digunakan untuk merujuk individu bernama Stefano.
senses.nuances: 输入未提供 DBP 释义，故不能确认为官方马来语普通词条；本项为专名说明。音标采用意大利语读法，实际称呼尊重本人发音。参见 [Dizionario Italiano Olivetti](https://www.dizionario-italiano.it/dizionario-italiano.php?lemma=STEFANO100)。以下是自然使用组合，不代表经语料统计的高频固定搭配。

dual_scenarios.ms: Stefano akan membentangkan laporan projek dalam mesyuarat esok.
dual_scenarios.zh: 斯特法诺将在明天的会议上汇报项目情况。
dual_scenarios.en: Stefano will present the project report at tomorrow's meeting.

etymology.historical_story: Stefano belongs to the Italian naming tradition associated with Greek Stephanos, meaning crown or wreath. Saint Stephen provides an important religious connection in that tradition. The historical image helps explain the name, but in a Malay sentence Stefano identifies a person rather than expressing the ordinary meaning crown. [Treccani](https://www.treccani.it/enciclopedia/santo-stefano_%28Enciclopedia-Italiana%29/).
